protocol.hypothesis: Preserve multi-week trends by requiring persistent structural deterioration before selling. Review stronger labels as technical confirmation, not higher expected profitability.
protocol.independence: Newly acquired historical prices were not used in the previous backtest. Rules are fixed before computing their returns. This is a locked historical holdout, not a chronological or prospective out-of-sample validation: later 2025-2026 observations motivated the design. Current-universe selection and revised data remain biases.

prospectiveValidation.changePolicy: Changing rules starts a new prospective version; never relabel previously examined data as untouched.

selection.universe: All 250 current instruments; unavailable pre-listing allocations remain cash; failures are not silently excluded.

rules.buy: Retain v2 entry family except an explicit structural SELL takes precedence in a conflict.
rules.persistentSell: Three consecutive closes below each day's SMA50, SMA50 today <= SMA50 five sessions ago, latest close < latest SMA50 minus one current ATR14. Minimum 55 bars.
rules.emergencySell: Latest close below prior-20-bar low minus one prior ATR14, below current SMA50 minus two prior ATR14, relative volume >=1.5, and falling close.
rules.confirmation: Both structural exit routes require a confirmed daily candle. No momentum-v2 gate. Each ATR unit has a 0.1%-of-corresponding-price floor.
rules.exitScore: 50% support depth (clamp(50-25*distanceToSMA50ATR)); 30% consecutive-below-SMA50 count divided by3; 20% SMA50 slope score (clamp(50-25*five-session-SMA50-change/currentATR)). Components and final score rounded to integers. Cap59 without confirmed structural exit; floor60 with one; emergency floor80.
rules.strongBuyInternal: Existing v2 strong-buy gates plus previous-bar close breaks preceding20-bar high and current close holds that same frozen level; current relative volume >=1.5, previous >=1.2, current close above SMA50.
rules.strongSellInternal: Persistent structural sell plus previous and current close below the same low20 frozen before the previous bar; current relative volume >=1.5, previous >=1.2. A single emergency day cannot be strong.
rules.strongPresentation: Display as Confirmed buy / Confirmed sell; extra technical confirmation does not imply validated superior return. Internal STRONG_* identifiers remain compatible.

execution.allocation: equal initial independent sleeves, fractional shares, no rebalance, no shorts, no cash interest

protocol.priceBasis: Signals use original quote OHLC exactly as production. Primary execution/valuation uses all OHLC multiplied by Yahoo adjclose/close per bar, a provider-adjusted total-return proxy. Quote-price sensitivity uses the SAME original-quote signals. Adjusted execution is a hypothetical synthetic series, not a historical executable quote.

evaluationCorrectionBeforeMetricInspecti.reason: The initial runner used adjusted OHLC for signals as well as returns, which differs from production input. Before inspecting any real return metrics, align quote-panel signals with adjusted-panel return bars by exact ticker/date. No scoring rules, thresholds, dates, costs or success criteria change.

protocol.primaryCriterion: Net cumulative return of v3 exceeds same-universe buy-and-hold in the historical holdout at5bps slippage. Separately report whether this holds in both fixed subperiods and at10bps. Reduced drawdown or turnover alone does not satisfy the return criterion.

inference.bootstrap: Paired aggregate daily return difference, circular blocks of20 sessions, 2000 replicates, seed20261019; exploratory, not correction for selection bias.
inference.events: Exclusive ordinary vs confirmed signal categories; family onsets, next-open entries, horizons5/10/20, nonoverlapping within ticker/category/horizon, costs both sides. SELL outcome is sell-cash-rebuy advantage versus holding, not short P/L. Correlated events are descriptive.
inference.smallStrongSamples: Fewer than50 events or10 instruments in a category/horizon is explicitly insufficient; no thresholds are adjusted to improve its result.

protocol.publishPolicy: Retain adverse outcomes. Report structural and trading-behavior improvements separately from economic validation. No claim of genuine prospective success before future observations exist.

input.cacheReuse: Require an exact cacheProvenance match against the current input, sources, settings and declared universe before reuse. Worker count is not a semantic parameter.
input.timing: Each signal uses only its own dated close and at most historyDays preceding bars; execute no earlier than the next contiguous session open.
limitations: Historical reconstruction is not evidence of original point-in-time data or universe availability.
The current universe may contain hindsight selection and survivorship bias.
An older previously uninspected holdout is not prospective or conventional forward chronological validation when design used later observations.
Capture latestDate does not label earlier historical bars stale; execution must separately validate exchange-calendar gaps.
Explicit provisional rows are excluded; unknown finality is counted and treated as stored history.
Only confirmed not_listed instrument records reserve empty cash sleeves; download failures are rejected.
This artifact contains signals only, not fitted thresholds, returns, commissions or profitability claims.
input.priceBasisNote: Signals are reconstructed from production quote OHLC; only execution and valuation use synthetic adjusted OHLC.

eventStudy.interpretation: Ordinary and confirmed categories are exclusive labels, but their windows can overlap across categories and tickers. ALL includes both. SELL = sell/cash/rebuy advantage versus holding in initial-value units; not short return. Descriptive correlated events, not independent trials.

newVsV2.interpretation: Exploratory 95% interval for the mean paired daily return difference; not a confidence interval for cumulative return, and not proof against universe selection or model-selection bias.

newVsBuyHold.interpretation: Exploratory 95% interval for the mean paired daily return difference; not a confidence interval for cumulative return, and not proof against universe selection or model-selection bias.

assumptions.allocation: Equal initial per-ticker sleeves; fractional shares; no rebalancing.
assumptions.inactiveTickers: Tickers with explicitly empty history keep their initial allocation in cash throughout; no redistribution or invented prices.
assumptions.execution: Previous completed session signal executes at the next contiguous session open.
assumptions.terminal: All holdings liquidated at the predeclared final close, including both-side costs. A missing final bar produces a flagged synthetic mark excluded from settled trade statistics.
assumptions.benchmark: Buy at first eligible evaluation-period open after 50 history bars and hold to terminal close.
assumptions.cagrBasis: Actual calendar-date span / 365.25, minimum one day.
assumptions.exposure: Mean invested share of equity at each close before any terminal liquidation.
assumptions.profitFactor: Sum of positive net settled trade profits / absolute sum of negative net settled trade profits; null if no losses.
assumptions.adjustment: Synthetic OHLC multiplied by provider adjclose/close; total-return proxy, not literal historical execution prices.

export.omitted: Daily curves, individual trades, executions and per-ticker books; the complete captured evaluation is preserved locally.
export.units: Returns and drawdowns without a Pct suffix are decimal fractions, not percentages. Equity and costs are USD. old=frozen baseline v2; new=candidate v3.
